subject.title: Add gated Claw discovery and API projection

question: Should ClawHub adopt `claw` as an experimental value in the existing public package-family API before the Claws RFC is accepted?
rationale: The implementation is gated, but it still establishes a new registry family and public response contract whose long-term compatibility cannot be decided from code correctness alone.

options.title: Hold for RFC and stack review
options.body: Keep the draft open and defer merge until the RFC and prerequisite publication model are approved, then review the rebased stack with live proof.

options.title: Approve the gated contract now
options.body: Accept the public family addition as explicitly unstable while the deployment gate is required and proceed with stack-order integration.

options.title: Keep discovery private
options.body: Retain storage and lifecycle experimentation but postpone public list, search, detail, and version projection until the contract stabilizes.

recommendation.title: Hold for RFC and stack review
recommendation.body: Keep the draft open and defer merge until the RFC and prerequisite publication model are approved, then review the rebased stack with live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a cross-repository product and compatibility decision, and the repository vision identifies Peter as the strongest available product-direction routing candidate.
